spans.s:
सं-√ दंश् P. -दशति, to bite together, seize with the teeth, MBh.; R.; BhP.;
to press together, compress, press closely on anything, indent by pressure, MBh.; Kālid.
compression (of the lips), MBh.
too great compression of the teeth in the pronunciation of vowels, RPrāt.
junction, connection, Subh.
a pair of tongs or pincers or nippers, AV.; Br.; Pur.; Suśr.
N. of those parts of the body which are used for grasping or seizing (as the thumb and forefinger together, the opposite eye-teeth, the nippers of a crab &c.), Yājñ.; VarBṛS.; Suśr.; Pañcat.; Kathās.
a partic. Naraka or hell (where the flesh of the wicked is tortured with pincers), Pur.
a chapter or section of a book, Dāyabh.
a partic. Ekāha, Vait.
the site of a village &c. (fixed according to the compass), L.
सं-˚दंशक m. (or f(इका). ) a pair of tongs or pincers or nippers, small shears or tongs, a vice, Daś.; Amar.
सं-˚दंशिका f. biting, pecking (with the beak), Lalit.
सं-˚दंशित mfn. armed, mailed, MBh. (B. स-द्˚)
सं-˚दंशित m. a defendant, L.
bitten, compressed, pressed closely together, pinched, nipped, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
a partic. fault in pronunciation (arising from keeping the teeth too close together), RPrāt.; Pat.
सं-दष्ट—कुसुम-शयन mfn. indenting (by pressure of the limbs) a couch of flowers, Śak.
सं-दष्ट—ता f. (= संदष्ट n.), RPrāt.
सं-दष्ट—दन्त-च्छद mfn. biting or compressing the lips, MW.
a Yamaka in which each quarter of the stanza begins with a word twice repeated, Bhar.
सं-दष्˚टाधर mfn. (-पल्लव) id., MBh.; Amar.
सं-दष्˚टौष्ठ mfn. (-पुट) id., MBh.; Amar.
सं-˚दष्टक n. a kind of paronomasia, L.
See सं-√ दस्.
See सं-√ दा, col. 2.
grasping, comprehending, RV.
pride, arrogance, boasting of (comp.), Kathās.
(√ 2. दृभ्; ifc. f(आ). ) stringing or binding together (esp. into a wreath or chaplet), weaving, arranging, collecting, mixing, uniting, Kāv.; Kathās.; Sarvad.
a literary or musical composition, Mcar.; Pratāp.; Mṛcch., Sch.
सं-दर्भ—ग्रन्थ m. (?) N. of wk. on the worship of Kṛṣṇa
सं-दर्भ—चिन्तामणि m. N. of a Comm. on the Śiśupālavadha by Candra-śekhara
सं-दर्भ—वत् mfn. artificially connected or composed, Harav.
सं-दर्भ—विरुद्ध mfn. contrary to order or consistency, incoherent, unconnected, MW.
सं-दर्भ—शुद्ध mfn. clearly arranged, coherent, connected, ib.
सं-दर्भ—शुद्धि f. clearness of connection or arrangement (as of the parts of a composition or narrative), regular coherence, Gīt.
सं-दर्˚भामृत-तोषिणी f. N. of a Comm. on the Mugdhabodha.
सं-˚दर्भित mfn. strung together, arranged, composed, L.
strung together, interwoven, bound or collected into a tuft or bunch, ŚBr.
arranged, composed, Naiṣ.
corroborated, confirmed (-त्व n.), Śaṃk.
See p. 1143, col. 1.
सं-दृब्ध—त्व n.
˚शन &c. See सं√ दृश्, p. 1144, col. 1.
sight, appearance, MBh.; BhP.
pierced through, pierced, Dhūrtas.
Nom. P. -दशस्यति, to remit, pardon (a sin), RV. iii, 7, 10.
सं-√ दस् (only pf. p. P. -ददस्व॑स्), to die out or become extinguished (as fire), RV. ii, 2, 6 (accord. to Sāy. सं-ददस्वस् = सम्यक्प्रयच्छत्).
burned up, consumed, TS.; &c.
burning up, consuming, MW.
inflammation of the mouth and lips, ib.
wishing to burn up or to consume by fire, MBh.; VarBṛS.; BhP.

सं-√ दा (or दो) P. -दाति, or -द्यति, to cut together, gather by or after cutting (as the sacrificial grass), KātyŚr.;
to cut, divide, AV.
सं-√ दा P. -द्यति, to bind together, fasten together, tie, RV.; AV.; VS.; KātyŚr.
1. सं-दाय mfn. giving, presenting (in गो-स्˚, q.v.)
2. सं-दाय m. a rein, leash, Hariv.
सं-˚दायिन् mfn. id., Subh.

सं-√ दा (or दो) P. -दाति, or -द्यति, to cut together, gather by or after cutting (as the sacrificial grass), KātyŚr.;
to cut, divide, AV.
1. सं-दान n. the act of cutting or dividing, MW.
that part of an elephant's temples whence the fluid called Mada issues (cf. 2. दान), W.
2. सं-दा॑न m. the part under the knee of an elephant where the fetter is fastened (also -भाग), L.
a bond, halter, fetter, RV.; AV.; ŚBr.
1. सं-दित mfn. cut off, cut, MW.
2. सं-दित mfn. bound or fastened together, detained, caught, R.; Hariv.
one who ties up or fetters, Mn. viii, 342.
2. सं-दान—ता f., Daś.
सं-˚दानिका f. a kind of tree, L.
सं-˚दानित mfn. bound together, tied, fettered, Kāv.
सं-˚दानितक n. a collection of three Ślokas forming one sentence, Naiṣ., Sch.
सं-˚दानिनी f. a cow-house, L.
w.r. for सं-दानितक.
flight, retreat, L.
bidding farewell, Divyāv.
pointed out, assigned &c.
stipulated, promised, Yājñ.
news, tidings, information, W.
सं-दिष्ट—वत् mfn. one who has given an order or message, to (gen.; also = pf. सं-दिदेश, ‘he-has given &c.’), Kathās.
सं-दिष्˚टार्थ m. one who communicates information or news, a messenger, herald, pursuivant, W.
(ifc. f(आ). ) communication of intelligence, message, information, errand, direction, command, order to (gen. or loc.; -तस् with gen., ‘by order of’), Kauś.; MBh. &c.
a present, gift, L.
a partic. kind of sweetmeat, L.
See सं-√ दिस्.
सं-देश—गिर् f. news, tidings, L.
सं-देश—पद n. pl. the words of a message, Ragh.
सं-देश—हर m. a news-bringer, messenger, envoy, ambassador, Kāv.
सं-देश—हरा (आ), f. a female messenger, Gal.
सं-देश—हार mfn. bringing news or tidings, Sāh.
सं-देश—हारक m. (= -हर) (Sāh.)
सं-देश—हारिन् m. (= -हर) (Śak.)
सं-दे˚शार्थ m. the contents of a message, Megh.
सं-˚देशक m. or n. information, news, tidings, Pañcat.
सं-˚देशित mfn. (fr. Caus.) made to point out, asked to declare, MBh.
सं-˚देश्य᳙ mfn. to be directed or instructed, Kathās.
founded on direction or impulse, done on purpose, AV.
belonging to this place, domestic (as opp. to वि-देश्य, ‘foreign’), AV.
सं-˚देष्टव्य mfn. to be informed or instructed, MBh.
to be pointed out or enjoined or communicated, Śak.
सं-˚देष्टव्य n. an injunction, direction, order, MW.
a heap, mound, wall, RV.
smeared over, besmeared or covered with (instr. or comp.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
confused, confounded with, mistaken for (instr. or comp.), Nir.; Kum.
questioned, questionable, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
precarious, doubtful, dubious, uncertain, unsettled, doubtful about, despairing of (comp.), ib.
riskful, dangerous, unsafe (as a ship), Gaut.
(अम्), n. an ambiguous suggestion or expression, Kpr.; Pratāp.
सं-दिग्ध—ता f. (MW.) uncertainty, hesitation, indistinctness
सं-दिग्ध—त्व n. (Sāh.) uncertainty, hesitation, indistinctness
सं-दिग्ध—निश्चय mfn. one who hesitates to hold a firm opinion, R.
सं-दिग्ध—पुनरुक्त-त्व n. uncertainty and tautology, Sāh.
सं-दिग्ध—फल mfn. having arrows with poisoned tips (accord. to others ‘of uncertain result or efficacy’), Daś.
सं-दिग्ध—बुद्धि (Śak.) mfn. having a doubtful mind, sceptical
सं-दिग्ध—मति (Yājñ.) mfn. having a doubtful mind, sceptical
सं-दिग्ध—लेख्य n. a writing or document of doubtful meaning or authority, W.
सं-दिग्˚धाक्षर mfn. having indistinct utterance, MW.
सं-दिग्˚धार्थ mfn. having doubtful meaning, dubious in sense, ib.
सं-दिग्˚धार्थ m. a doubtful or disputed matter, Yājñ. ii, 12
सं-दिग्˚धी-कृत mfn. made to present a doubtful resemblance, Bālar. vi, 31.
inclined to doubt, L.
a conglomeration of material elements (said contemptuously of the body), ŚBr.
(ifc. f(आ). ) a conglomeration or conglutination (of material elements; see above), ŚBr.; ChUp.
doubt, uncertainty about (gen. loc., or comp.; न or नास्ति संदेहः or संदेहो नास्ति [used parenthetically], ‘there is no doubt, without doubt’), Āpast.; MBh. &c.
(in rhet.) a figure of speech expressive of doubt (e.g. ‘is this a lotus flower or an eye?’), Vām. iv, 3, 11
risk, danger, Kāv.; Pañcat.
See सं-√ दिह्.
सं-देह—गन्ध m. a whiff or slight tinge of doubt, MW.
सं-देह—च्छेदन n. cutting i.e. removal of d˚, Kām.
सं-देह—त्व n. state of d˚ or uncertainty, Sāh.
सं-देह—दायिन् mfn. raising d˚ or unc˚ concerning i.e. reminding of (comp.), Vās.
सं-देह—दोला f. the oscillation or perplexity (caused by) d˚, MBh.
सं-देह—दोला-स्थ mfn. ‘one who is in a state of suspense’, Kām.
सं-देह—पद mfn. subject to d˚, doubtful, Kālid.
सं-देह—भञ्जन n. breaking or destroying d˚, Kām.
सं-देह—भञ्जिका f. N. of wk.
सं-देह—भृत् mfn. having d˚ about (loc.), Mcar.
सं-देह—विषौ˚षधि f. N. of wk.
सं-देह—समुच्चय m. N. of wk.
सं-दे˚हापनोदन n. (= -च्छेदन), APrāt., Sch.
सं-दे˚हालंकार m. a partic. figure of speech (cf. above), Sāh.; Pratāp.
सं-दे˚हालंकृति f. a partic. figure of speech (cf. above), Sāh.; Pratāp.
सं-˚देहयान See सं√ दिह्.
सं-˚देहिन् mfn. doubtful, dubious, MW.
सं-˚देह्य m. the body (= सं-देह), BṛĀrUp.

सं-√ दी (only Impv. -दीदिहि, or -दिदीहि), to shine together, VS.;
to bestow by shining, RV.
w.r. for आसन्दी.
consecrated together, KātyŚr., Sch.
greatly depressed or afflicted, Hariv.
inflaming, exciting, making envious or jealous, Gīt.
सं-˚दीपन mfn. kindling, inflaming, exciting, arousing, MBh.; Uttarar.
सं-˚दीपन m. N. of one of Kāma-deva's 5 arrows, Vet.
सं-˚दीपन n. the act of kindling or inflaming or exciting (envy &c.), Ṛtus.; Pañcar.
सं-˚दीपनी (ई), f. (in music) a partic. Śruti, Saṃgīt.

N. of a Muni (accord. to VP. he was the tutor of Kṛṣṇa and Bala-rāma, and requested as his preceptor's fee that his son, supposed to be drowned in the sea but kept under the waters by the demon Pañca-jana, should be restored to him; Kṛṣṇa plunged into the sea, killed the demon, and brought back the boy to his father), Hariv.; Kād.; Pur.
सं-˚दीपन—वत् mfn. containing inflammable matter, KātyŚr.
सं-˚दीपित mfn. (fr. Caus.) lighted up, kindled, inflamed, excited, Pañcat.; BhP.
inflamed, flaming, burning, being on fire, ŚBr. &c. &c.
सं-दीप्त—लोचन mfn. one who has inflamed or flashing eyes, Hariv.
Celosia Cristata, L.
corrupted, defiled &c.
depraved, wicked, bad, R.
ill-disposed, ill-affected towards (gen.), ib.
corrupting, defiling, Mn. ix, 13
the act of vitiating or corrupting, any vice which causes defilement, Yājñ.
सं-दूषण—कर mf(ई)n. defiling, disgracing (gen.), Hariv.
सं-˚दूषित mfn. (fr. id.) utterly corrupted or vitiated or spoiled, Hariv.
made or grown worse (as a disease), Suśr.
exposed to shame, reviled, abused, MBh.
milked at the same time, milked together, MW.
सं-˚दुह्या See सुख-संदुह्या.
milking together, milking, Hariv.; BhP.
the whole milk (of a herd), Nār.; Hariv.
totality, multitude, heap, mass, abundance, Kāv.; Kathās. &c.
, ˚हन, ˚ह्या. See सं√ डुह्, col. 1.
सं-˚दोहन mfn. yielding (as milk), bestowing, Śukas.
सं-˚दोह्या See सुख-संदोह्या.
(ए dat. as inf.; cf. above) sight, appearance, RV. (सम्यक् पश्यति यः, ‘one who sees well or thoroughly’, Sāy.), AV.; VS.; KaṭhUp.
view, direction, RV. ii, 13, 10.

the act of looking steadfastly gazing, viewing, beholding, seeing, sight, vision (स्वप्ने संदर्श˚नं-√ गम्, ‘to be seen by or appear to [gen.] in a dream’; ˚नम्प्र-√ यम्, ‘to show one's self to [gen.]’; ˚ने, ‘in view or in the presence of [gen. or comp.]’), Nir.; KātyŚr.; MBh. &c.
a gaze, look, R.; Sāh.
surveying, inspection, consideration, MBh.; Vikr.; Hit.
appearance, manifestation, Kāv.; Sāh.
the rising of a heavenly body with the sun, VarBṛS.
meeting or falling in with (instr. with or without सह), Kathās.; Pañcat. (fr. Caus.) the act of causing to see, showing, displaying, exhibition of or to (comp.), MBh.; R.; Pur.
a partic. manner of subsistence, Baudh.
सं-दर्शन—द्वीप m. N. of a Dvīpa, R.
सं-दर्शन—पथ m. the range of sight, Hariv.
causing to see, showing, pointing out, Nir.
सं-˚दर्शित mfn. shown, displayed, manifested, Mālav.
represented, Gīt.
wishing to show, Bhaṭṭ.
wishing to see, MBh.
सं-˚दृश See मधुसंदृश.
सं-˚दृश्य mfn. to be looked at i.e. appearing as (nom.), MBh.
completely seen or beheld (पाप-स्˚, ‘having an evil aspect’), VarBṛS.
foreseen, ordained, prescribed (in sacred books), R.
complete sight, full view, aspect, RV.
सं-˚दृष्टिक w.r. for सांद्˚, Divyāv.
visible or perceptible at the same time, relating to present perception, appearing at once or immediately, L.
evident, undeniable, VarBṛS.
present perception of a result, immediate consequence, L.
to be seen or sought for, MBh.
सं-˚द्रष्टृ mfn. one who sees well or beholds, Nir.; BhP.
(or f(आ). ) a kind of pendulous ornament, Pañcar.
सं-√ द्रु P. -द्रवति, to run together, RV.
flight, L.
running together, a place where people run together, Pat. on Pāṇ. v, 1, 119,
Vārtt. 5
flight, L.
gait, manner of walking, Bhaṭṭ.
w.r. for शाण्डिल्य.
mf(आ)n. (of unknown derivation) viscid, unctuous, oily, Suśr.
thick, solid, compact, dense, Kāv.; Kathās.; Pur.
strong, vehement intense, Kālid.; Daś.; Prab.
studded or crowded with, full of (instr. or comp.), Naiṣ.; Prab.
smooth, soft, bland, tender, Kālid.; Vās.
a wood, thicket, L.
a heap, cluster, W.
सान्द्र—कुतूहल mfn. having intense curiosity, MW.
सान्द्र—कुतूहल n. N. of a Prahasana.
सान्द्र—तम mfn. most compact or dense, Śiś.
सान्द्र—तर mfn. more (or most) vehement or intense (अम् ind.), ib.
सान्द्र—तरम् (अम्), ind.
सान्द्र—ता f. thickness, denseness, vehemence, intensity, Gīt.
सान्द्र—त्व n. id., MW.
सान्द्र—त्वक्-क mfn. provided with a thick skin or covering, Śiś.
सान्द्र—पद n. a kind of metre, Ked.
सान्द्र—पुष्प m. ‘having thick clustering flowers’, the tree Terminalia Bellerica, L.
सान्द्र—प्रसाद-मेह m. a kind of diabetes, Car.
सान्द्र—मणि m. N. of a man, Saṃskārak.
सान्द्र—मूत्र mfn. discharging viscous urine, Car.
सान्द्र—मेह m. a kind of diabetes, ib.
सान्द्र—मे˚हिन् mfn. suffering from it, ib.
सान्द्र—स्निग्ध mfn. thick and unctuous, L.
सान्द्र—स्पर्श mfn. unctuous or soft to the touch, Mālav.
in comp. for सान्द्र.
सान्द्री—कृत mfn. made thick or dense, Ragh.
increased, strengthened, Vās.
सान्द्री—√ भू P. -भवति, to become thick, Car.
running together from all sides, Pāṇ. iii, 3, 44, Sch.
